extractedItems.title: Penalty for hitting the wrong ball in a penalty area
extractedItems.question: If you play a shot from a penalty area and accidentally hit the wrong ball, what is the penalty?

choices.text: No penalty, just play again
1 stroke penalty and replay the shot
2 penalty strokes and you must play the correct ball
Lose the hole

extractedItems.explanation: If you hit the wrong ball from a penalty area, you get 2 penalty strokes and must go back and play the correct ball.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer accidentally hitting a golf ball that does not belong to her from a red-staked penalty area beside a blue stream.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Girl golfer in penalty area by water accidentally striking wrong ball

extractedItems.ruleName: Penalty area – Ball lost or not out
extractedItems.title: What happens if you hit your ball into the water again from a penalty area?
extractedItems.question: You hit a shot from a penalty area, but your ball ends up lost or goes into the water in the penalty area. What must you do next?

choices.text: Drop a new ball outside the penalty area without penalty
Proceed under the penalty area rule with 1 penalty stroke
No penalty is given, play on from where it entered the water
Replay the shot with 2 penalty strokes

extractedItems.explanation: You must take relief in line with the penalty area rule, with a 1-stroke penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer hitting a golf ball from a penalty area, the ball splashing into water ahead.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen boy golfer hits ball from penalty area and it splashes back into water

extractedItems.ruleName: Penalty area – Ball out of bounds or lost
extractedItems.title: Ball from penalty area goes out of bounds
extractedItems.question: If you play from a penalty area and your ball goes out of bounds, what are your options?

choices.text: Drop a ball with 1 penalty stroke within 1 club-length of your last stroke back into the penalty area
Accept another 1-stroke penalty and proceed using the penalty area rule
Play a free drop from where the ball went out of bounds
Replay the shot without penalty

extractedItems.explanation: You can drop within a club-length of your previous spot in the penalty area with 1 penalty stroke, or take another penalty stroke and use normal penalty area relief.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer standing at the edge of a penalty area, looking at her ball that has flown over a red stake and gone out of bounds.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen girl golfer sees her ball from penalty area fly out of bounds

extractedItems.title: If you accidentally double-hit the ball
extractedItems.question: What is the penalty if you accidentally hit the golf ball twice in one swing?

choices.text: No penalty – it only counts as one stroke
1 penalty stroke is added
2 penalty strokes are added
You must replay the shot

extractedItems.explanation: If you double-hit the ball by accident, it only counts as one stroke with no penalty.
